types.name: notifications.v1.BrokerAllowlistAction
types.doc: BrokerAllowlistAction is what a broker vault payout address change does.

values.name: ADD_DESTINATION
values.doc: Adds the address to the vault's payout address allowlist.

values.name: REMOVE_DESTINATION
values.doc: Removes the address from the vault's payout address allowlist.

types.name: notifications.v1.BrokerAllowlistEvent
types.doc:
BrokerAllowlistEvent is what happened to a broker vault payout address
 change.

values.name: CHANGE_REQUESTED
values.doc: A member requested the change.

values.name: CHANGE_APPLIED
values.doc: The change was applied.

values.name: CHANGE_NOT_APPLIED
values.doc: The change was not applied, and never will be; nothing changed.

types.name: notifications.v1.BrokerAllowlistNotice
types.doc:
BrokerAllowlistNotice is a change of a QuickSwap broker vault's payout
 address allowlist, as the broker's records show it. Read the change with
 QuickSwapBrokerService.ListVaultAllowlistChanges.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: vault_account_id
fields.doc: Public sub-account ID of the vault.

fields.name: change_id
fields.doc: Public ID of the change, as ListVaultAllowlistChanges returns it.

fields.name: event
fields.doc: What happened to the change.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: What the change does.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc: Destination chain identifier of the address.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc: The address, in canonical form.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: The requesting member's name for an added address; empty when none.

fields.name: requested_by_account_id
fields.doc: Public account ID of the member who requested the change.

types.name: notifications.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc: ErrorCode identifies a Notification API error.

values.name: NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND
values.doc:
No notification of the caller has this ID. Another account's
 notification is reported the same way.

values.name: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A required service is temporarily unavailable; retry the same request.

types.name: notifications.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to Notification API errors as an error detail of
 type notifications.v1.ErrorDetail.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code.

types.name: notifications.v1.GetNotificationCountsRequest
types.doc: GetNotificationCountsRequest counts the caller's notifications.

types.name: notifications.v1.GetNotificationCountsResponse
types.doc:
GetNotificationCountsResponse returns exact counts of the caller's
 notifications, as of one moment.

fields.name: total
fields.doc: Number of notifications.

fields.name: unread
fields.doc: Number of notifications the caller has not read.

fields.name: types
fields.doc:
Counts of every type, in ascending enum order, including types with no
 notification.

types.name: notifications.v1.GetNotificationRequest
types.doc: GetNotificationRequest reads one notification of the caller.

fields.name: notification_id
fields.doc: Public notification ID.

types.name: notifications.v1.GetNotificationResponse
types.doc: GetNotificationResponse returns the notification.

fields.name: notification
fields.doc: The notification.

types.name: notifications.v1.ListNotificationsRequest
types.doc: ListNotificationsRequest lists the caller's notifications.

fields.name: categories
fields.doc:
Return only notifications in these categories. Empty returns every
 category.

fields.name: read_state
fields.doc: Return only read or only unread notifications. Unspecified returns both.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc:
Return only notifications created at or after this time. Omitted means
 no lower bound.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc:
Return only notifications created before this time. Omitted means no
 upper bound. Must be after start_time when both are set.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of notifications to return: default 25, max 100.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, keyset-backed and exclusive cursor from a previous response's
 next_page_token. It is bound to the caller, categories, read_state,
 start_time and end_time; reuse it only with the same values.

types.name: notifications.v1.ListNotificationsResponse
types.doc: ListNotificationsResponse returns one page of the caller's notifications.

fields.name: notifications
fields.doc: Notifications, newest first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: notifications.v1.MarkAllNotificationsReadRequest
types.doc:
MarkAllNotificationsReadRequest marks every unread notification of the
 caller read, within the given categories.

fields.name: categories
fields.doc: Mark only notifications in these categories. Empty marks every category.

fields.name: through_notification_id
fields.doc:
Mark only this notification and older ones: pass the newest notification
 the caller has shown, so one that arrives later stays unread. Zero marks
 every notification that exists when the call is processed.

types.name: notifications.v1.MarkAllNotificationsReadResponse
types.doc:
MarkAllNotificationsReadResponse reports what MarkAllNotificationsRead
 changed.

fields.name: changed
fields.doc: Number of notifications this call marked read.

types.name: notifications.v1.MarkNotificationsReadRequest
types.doc: MarkNotificationsReadRequest marks notifications of the caller read.

fields.name: notification_ids
fields.doc: Public notification IDs: one to 100, distinct.

types.name: notifications.v1.MarkNotificationsReadResponse
types.doc: MarkNotificationsReadResponse reports what MarkNotificationsRead changed.

fields.name: changed
fields.doc:
Number of notifications this call marked read. Notifications already
 read are not counted.

types.name: notifications.v1.MarkNotificationsUnreadRequest
types.doc: MarkNotificationsUnreadRequest marks notifications of the caller unread.

fields.name: notification_ids
fields.doc: Public notification IDs: one to 100, distinct.

types.name: notifications.v1.MarkNotificationsUnreadResponse
types.doc:
MarkNotificationsUnreadResponse reports what MarkNotificationsUnread
 changed.

fields.name: changed
fields.doc:
Number of notifications this call marked unread. Notifications already
 unread are not counted.

types.name: notifications.v1.NoticeField
types.doc:
NoticeField is one labelled value of a notice, for example "Market" and
 "BTC/USDT".

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Short label, in plain words: 1 to 64 bytes.

fields.name: value
fields.doc:
The value, in plain words, with its unit or asset when it has one: 1 to
 256 bytes.

types.name: notifications.v1.Notification
types.doc: Notification is one notification of the caller.

fields.name: notification_id
fields.doc: Public notification ID.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: What the notification reports.

fields.name: category
fields.doc: Category of the type.

fields.name: title
fields.doc:
Short plain-text title, the same for every notification of a type, for
 example "Price alert".

fields.name: text
fields.doc:
Plain-text summary of what happened, at most 4096 bytes. It may span
 several lines.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the notification was created.

fields.name: read_at
fields.doc: When the caller marked it read. Omitted while it is unread.

fields.name: price_alert
fields.doc: The price alert that fired.

fields.name: telegram_approval
fields.doc: The action approved from the linked Telegram account.

fields.name: broker_allowlist
fields.doc: The broker vault payout address change.

types.name: notifications.v1.NotificationCategory
types.doc: NotificationCategory groups notification types for filtering and counts.

values.name: ALERTS
values.doc: Alerts the caller set, such as price alerts.

values.name: SECURITY
values.doc:
Security of the account, such as actions approved from a linked
 Telegram account.

types.name: notifications.v1.NotificationType
types.doc:
NotificationType is what a notification reports. Each type belongs to one
 category, and its detail is the matching field of Notification.detail.

values.name: PRICE_ALERT
values.doc: A price alert of the caller fired. Category ALERTS; detail price_alert.

values.name: TELEGRAM_APPROVAL
values.doc:
An action was approved from the Telegram account linked to the caller's
 account. Category SECURITY; detail telegram_approval. If the caller did
 not approve it, the linked Telegram account may be in someone else's
 hands: unlink it and review the account's sessions.

values.name: BROKER_ALLOWLIST_CHANGE
values.doc:
A payout address of a QuickSwap broker vault the caller is an Owner or
 Finance member of was requested to be added or removed, or the change
 was applied or not. Category SECURITY; detail broker_allowlist. If no
 member of the broker requested it, act before the address becomes
 payable: an added address is payable 24 hours after it is listed.

types.name: notifications.v1.PriceAlertNotice
types.doc: PriceAlertNotice is a price alert that fired, as it was when it fired.

fields.name: alert_id
fields.doc: Public alert ID, as the Price Alert API returns it.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier; resolve its symbol with GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Price crossing the alert waited for.

fields.name: price_source
fields.doc: Price the alert watched.

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: Alert price in quote units scaled by 1e9.

fields.name: triggered_price_ticks
fields.doc: Price that fired the alert, in quote units scaled by 1e9.

fields.name: triggered_at
fields.doc: When the alert fired.

types.name: notifications.v1.ReadState
types.doc: ReadState filters notifications by whether the caller has read them.

values.name: UNREAD
values.doc: Only notifications the caller has not read.

values.name: READ
values.doc: Only notifications the caller has read.

types.name: notifications.v1.TelegramApprovalAction
types.doc: TelegramApprovalAction is what an approval from Telegram approved.

values.name: PLACE_ORDER
values.doc: Place one order.

values.name: PLACE_ORDERS
values.doc: Place several limit orders together.

values.name: MODIFY_ORDERS
values.doc: Change open limit orders.

values.name: CANCEL_ORDER
values.doc: Cancel an order or a trigger.

values.name: CANCEL_ALL_ORDERS
values.doc: Cancel every open order of a market or of the account.

values.name: MODIFY_TRIGGER
values.doc: Change a trigger.

values.name: PAUSE_TRIGGER
values.doc: Pause a trigger.

values.name: RESUME_TRIGGER
values.doc: Resume a paused trigger.

values.name: SWAP
values.doc: Swap between assets within the trading account.

types.name: notifications.v1.TelegramApprovalNotice
types.doc:
TelegramApprovalNotice is an action approved from the Telegram account
 linked to the caller's account, as the approval recorded it.

fields.name: approval_id
fields.doc: The approval's ID, as the Assistant API returns it.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: What the approval approved.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public ID of the trading account (sub-account) the action acted on.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: summary
fields.doc: What approving did, written from the exact action: 1 to 512 bytes.

fields.name: parameters
fields.doc:
The action's key parameters in display order, such as the market, side,
 quantity and prices, from the same exact action: at most 16.

fields.name: approved_at
fields.doc: When the approval was given.

types.name: notifications.v1.TypeCount
types.doc: TypeCount counts the caller's notifications of one type.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: The type.

fields.name: category
fields.doc: Category of the type.

fields.name: total
fields.doc: Number of notifications of the type.

fields.name: unread
fields.doc: Number of those the caller has not read.
